message.content:
An editorial illustration features a man in a white long-sleeved shirt viewed from behind. He is standing before a large circular emblem containing a stylized bull’s head with prominent horns. Holding a rectangular grey eraser in his right hand, the man is in the process of wiping away a thick, diagonal black stroke that covers a portion of the bull’s head. This creates a textured, smeared appearance against the dark, grainy background.

The magazine title “TEMPO” is positioned in large red letters at the top. Above it, text in white reads, “Korupsi Covid-19 Mengalir sampai Jauh H.70” and “Konsolidasi Tambang Ormas Keagamaan H.80”. Below the title, the tagline “ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU” appears in small red letters. To the lower left, white text states, “BERSETERU SAMPAI AKHIR,” followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with “Perselisihan Presiden Jokowi-Megawati Soekarnoputri...” and ending with “H.26”. The bottom right displays the date “5-11 AGUSTUS 2024,” the price “RP 50.000,” and publication details including a barcode and a QR code.
